structured.approach: Loaded the data-science-steps skill for DS-06, then read task.code and feat.stories. task.code plans CMP-4 (a new tests/test_risk.py with five named tests) and CMP-5 (two tests added to tests/test_forecast.py), and lists the missed lines. I read ci.py to see how tests are found and how coverage is measured. I wrote tests that map one-to-one to AC-03.1–AC-03.8 and AC-04.1–AC-04.5. Following lesson L-007, they test the 30 and 10 boundaries explicitly, including rounded-mean cases. They also check that vendor_risk never touches load_config, which is mocked. I added one extra test showing any iterable is accepted. CI passed on the first run. git status confirmed that only files under tests/ changed in this step. Then I wrote task.unit_tests.md with the AC mapping, the verbatim CI output, the secrets findings and the open questions. Shell use was limited to the allowed commands: ci.py and git status.

claims.text: A new tests/test_risk.py adds VendorRiskTest with 6 tests for vendor_risk, covering AC-03.1 to AC-03.8, including the exact 30 and 10 boundaries.
tests/test_forecast.py gains test_request_with_risk and test_request_without_risk_unchanged for AC-04.1 to AC-04.5; the 3 existing tests are unchanged.
Boundary tests run on the rounded prediction: predict_delay_days([30, 31]) is 30, which gives 'medium', and predict_delay_days([10, 11]) is 10, which gives 'low'.
After this step the CI run reports compile true, 11 tests run, 0 failures, 0 errors, coverage 100.0, no static issues and passed true.
Before this step, CI failed only on coverage: 83.3, with risk.py lines 17-20 and explain.py line 21 not covered.
The tests need no secret, credential or network call in any environment; models.json holds only provider, model and max_tokens.
Per feat.stories SA-6, a lane may add new test files instead of using the existing one; task.code plans CMP-4 as a new tests/test_risk.py.

open_questions: CQ-DS-1: please confirm the test file split at review. The new tests/test_risk.py holds the STORY-03 tests; the STORY-04 tests are added to tests/test_forecast.py.
UT-1: AC-03.5 (PQ-1), AC-03.6 (TQ-5) and AC-04.5 (TQ-4) are tested against interim answers. If any answer changes, the matching assertion must change too.
Carried from task.code, unchanged: CQ-C2 (version 0.10.0), CQ-DS-3, RAQ-1, TQ-8, PQ-5.
structured.summary: CI now passes for ap_forecast: 11 tests, 0 failures, 100.0% coverage (the gate is 90%), no static issues. I added 6 vendor_risk tests in a new tests/test_risk.py and 2 build_explanation_request tests in tests/test_forecast.py. Together they cover all 13 STORY-03 and STORY-04 acceptance criteria, including the exact 30 and 10 boundary days. This closes the coverage gap left after DS-05 (CQ-C1). Only files under tests/ changed in this step, and nothing is committed. The output is in task.unit_tests.md. There are no blocking questions.
